text:
sarah-evans: Quick sync — FinEdge wants a short POC to validate doc-summarization + retrieval with strict latency and cost targets. Need to lock success criteria and who's doing what today.
ajay-patel: TL;DR — they asked for p95 latency ~300ms, sustained 40 QPS, cost target <$0.50/1k tokens, and quality threshold roughly 85% pass on their labeled prompts.
maria-gomez: We need a prompt suite. Recommend 100 prompts across 3 verticals (invoices, contracts, emails). Also need labeled ground truth to compute pass rates.
chris-ng: 300ms p95 is tight at 1k seq on hosted. Recommend we offer two options: (A) Dedicated + quantized 12B with p95 ~350-450ms, or (B) 7B low-latency model p95 ~200-300ms but possible quality delta. Call out fallback policy.
sarah-evans: Customer also requests "no model data retention" and KMS-managed keys. That pushes them to Dedicated or Private. Sales preference: start Dedicated.
ajay-patel: Quick burn calc: if they run 10k queries/day * avg 200 tokens = 2M tokens/day. At $0.50/1k => ~$1k/day. We'll show pricing tiers and trial credits.
maria-gomez: Proposal for acceptance gating: (1) Quality: labeled pass rate >=85% across prompt suite; (2) Latency: p95 <=400ms for their common 95% seq length; (3) Reliability: error rate <1% and uptime >= 99.5% during eval window.
ops-bot: provision-request: dedicated-cluster FinEdge-POC queued. ETA ~36h.
chris-ng: For evaluation we should run A/B: model-A (opt-12b-quant), model-B (7b-fast). Route 80/20, collect quality metrics and latency. If quality delta >2 points prefer higher quality model.
sarah-evans: Deliverables checklist for POC kickoff: prompt suite (100), labeled evals (per prompt), perf runbook (scripts + thresholds), security matrix (KMS/SSO/SOC2), cost memo. Who will take prompts?
ajay-patel: I can own prompt generation + initial labeling. Will need 2 reviewers.
maria-gomez: I'll own perf runbook, perf tests, and collecting latency histograms. I'll also set up prefix/KV cache tests.
chris-ng: I'll handle model configs, quantization profiles, and fallback routing policy. I'll attach perf script and quickstart snippet to the runbook.
sarah-evans: Timeline suggestion: week0 (scoping + kickoff), week1 (prompt labeling + baseline runs), week2 (perf runs + A/B), week3 (final tuning + acceptance demo).
ajay-patel: Security checklist for presales: KMS type, customer-managed keys, SOC2 artifacts, and residency. I have draft answers for their questionnaire.
maria-gomez: Acceptance flow: if quality <85 but latency OK, propose extended tuning + focused eval on failing prompts. If cost overshoot >20% vs estimate, escalate to pricing owner for approval.
sarah-evans: I'll schedule kickoff with FinEdge Monday 10am PT. @chris-ng confirm cluster ETA and you can share perf script in the kickoff doc.
chris-ng: Confirmed ETA ~36h. Attaching quick perf snippet in channel after kickoff.
chris-ng: snippet:
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"opt-12b-q","prompt":"<document>\nSummarize: ..."}'
```
ajay-patel: Noted. I'll also prepare a short cost sensitivity table (vary qps / token length).
maria-gomez: One more thing — include eval gating for semantic drift: if top-3 similarity drops 10% vs baseline, trigger retrain/tune.
sarah-evans: Great. I'll send a one-pager to the customer after kickoff with the checklist and timeline. :thumbsup:
ajay-patel: +1. looping in legal for the KMS clause. @legal please review.
legal: Received — will review KMS + retention clause within 48h.
sarah-evans: Thanks everyone, will update thread after kickoff.
